globalRules.eventOrdering: Accepted mutation appends eventId, previousEventId and aggregateVersion in same transaction.
globalRules.cas: Only the eight canonical table.field versions in coverage.versionCasDictionary are Book Lab CAS fields; core photo/placement versions are read-only references.
globalRules.retry: Same idempotency key returns original committed result.
globalRules.readDenial: Any canReadVersion failure returns book_version_unavailable before projection, cache, signed URL or artifact lookup.
globalRules.canReadVersion: (currentCoreOwnerBranch OR currentCoreAccountViewPredicate OR currentCoreExternalViewPredicate) AND book_version_access_controls.status=active AND manifestState=frozen AND bookVersion.status=available AND EVERY source grant is active AND EVERY source grant audienceScope=current_live_space_viewers AND EVERY frozen source reloads current Core photos.version equal to its manifest sourcePhotosVersion with photoContentState=visible, deletedAt=null, unchanged photoContentHash and current placementRevisionId equal to frozen placementRevisionId
globalRules.currentCoreOwnerBranch: Account session and family are active/revalidated; both issuedSessionEpoch values equal accounts.sessionEpoch; Space is live with spaceLifecycle=active; accountId equals spaces.ownerAccountId. Owner mutations lock-read and revalidate this branch inside the business transaction.
globalRules.independence: No transition writes core upload, placement, sharing, album or viewer aggregates.
globalRules.answerRevision: Every save appends an immutable user AnswerSubmission; confirmation binds one submission id/hash; no transition rewrites an answer.
globalRules.draftInvalidation: BOOK_MEMORY.AUTHORIZE, BOOK_MEMORY.WITHDRAW, MEMORY.WITHDRAW and SOURCE_REVOKED invalidate queued/ready/failed previews to stale, filter projections immediately, and discard old worker results by exact input hash.
globalRules.sourceRevocation: SOURCE_REVOKED also moves every affected rendering/available/render_failed BookVersion to withdrawal_affected and every affected non-purged RenderArtifact to revoked; old manifests remain immutable and unreadable, and a new version excludes the source.
globalRules.staleCas: BOOK_MEMORY.AUTHORIZE advances the target current book_draft_versions.version; MEMORY.WITHDRAW advances every affected current draft; BOOK.EDIT_TITLE advances memory_books.version and current book_draft_versions.version together. Each is serializable and tombstones old worker input before commit so stale cannot be lost.
globalRules.rendererInput: Renderer reads only immutable FrozenBookManifest, AuthorizedMemoryText snapshots and frozen local assets; no transition permits a live PersonalMemory read or user-text rewrite.
